text:
noah: QuasarWorks (QW-331) invoice INV-2025-412 is 49 days overdue. CFO says they want a pro-rata adjustment for a partial month and to pay remainder over 3 installments. cc @anya @omar

anya: any usage disputes? ledger shows $36,200 outstanding, no disputes.

omar: collections prefers PA + upfront payment. what's the pro-rata amount they requested?

maria: CS forwarded their note: they want $4,200 off for the partial month, then pay the remaining $32,000 in 3 monthly payments. they offered card on file or ACH.

noah: proposal: apply one-time credit of $4,200, revise invoice to $32,000. Require 20% upfront ($6,400) within 5 business days, then two equal installments of $12,800. waive the late fee if PA signed and first payment clears. include 5-day cure window and right to suspend if default.

anya: Legal ok with standard PA wording. Billing: please create rev and attach PA template.

billing-bot: Created revision INV-2025-412.rev1. Credit CR-PRO-RATA applied. Link: https://billing.internal/redwood/invoices/INV-2025-412/rev1 :white_check_mark:

collections-bot: Placed temporary hold on escalation while PA and upfront payment pending. Reminder scheduled in 7 days.

omar: once txn id is posted, finance will clear delinquency. require ACH mandate if card declines.

maria: CS will collect signed PA and card/ACH details; uploaded their acceptance screenshot to #customer-docs. they said "will sign and pay 20% ASAP."

noah: thanks team. I'll send PA + revised invoice with a 5-business-day deadline. If we don't see payment by then, remove hold and resume collections. :hourglass:
